sentences.en: Clerks with sticky fingers won't keep their jobs for long.
sentences.zh: 贪污的职员不会在岗位上待很久。

sentences.en: "You can get it at the courthouse," the clerk added.
sentences.zh: 你可以在法院拿到这个，”办事员补充说。

sentences.en: The clerk said, "What can I do for you, sir?"
sentences.zh: 办事员说道：‘先生，您有什么需要帮忙的吗？’
